title: Routine Heat
reference: F1 F1 F1 def F1 { forward wait forward forward turn_right }
hints: Every side of the stall walk is the same: same steps, same pause.
Write one side in F1 and call it three times.
F1 F1 F1 def F1 { forward wait forward forward turn_right }

story.intro: PATCH: "The Sky Bazaar. Stalls, awnings, and vents under every rug. Remember F1? Write a routine once, call it by name."
